notes.zh: 审阅说明：巨型船坞每完成一个建造阶段，由 on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded 在建造国触发对应事件（并非选项链接）；各阶段按建造顺序排列。
notes.en: Review note: each build stage of the Mega Shipyard fires its own event for the builder from on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded (not option links); stages are shown in construction order.

notes.zh: 审阅说明：废墟是地图上预置的，不属于任何建造阶段；首次进入该星系时由 on_entering_system_first_time 触发。
notes.en: Review note: the ruin is a pre-placed map object, not a build stage; on_entering_system_first_time fires this event the first time a ship enters the system.
